senses.gloss:
(उ) क्रुञ्चु r. 1st cl. (क्रुञ्चति)
1 To go, to approach to wards or arrive at.
2 To move crookedly.
3 To be crooked.
4 To curve or make crooked.
5 To become small, to shrink.
6 To make small, to lessen; also कुञ्च.

m. (-ञ्चः)
A name of the mountain Krouncha.
f. (-ञ्चा)
A kind of Vīṇā or lute.
E.
क्रुञ्च to be crooked, affixes क and टाप्.

mf. (क्रुङ् क्रुञ्चा)
A curlew.
E.
क्रुञ्च to go crookedly, affix क्विन्, fem. affix टाप्.

r. 6th cl. (क्रुडति)
To sink.
2 To be childish.
3 To eat.
4 To be thick.

mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं)
1 Angry, wrathful.
2 Fierce, cruel.
n. (-द्धं)
Anger.
E.
क्रुध to be angry, क्त aff.

(औ, ऌ) औक्रुधॢ r. 4th cl. (क्रुध्यति)
To be wrathful, to be flushed with anger.

f. (-धा)
Anger: see the preceding.

f. (क्रुत्) or (-क्रुद्)
Anger, passion.
E.
क्रुध to be angry, affix क्विप्; also with अङ् and टाप् affixes, क्रुधा.

mfn. (-ध्यन्-ध्यन्ती-ध्यत्)
Being angry.
E.
क्रुध, and शतृ aff.

r. 9th cl. (क्रुथ्नाति)
1 To be connected with, to cling or adhere to.
2 To be distressed, to suffer pain.

r. 1st cl. (-क्रोशति)
1 To call.
2 To cry, to weep.
With अनु prefixed,
To feel for, to sympathise with.
With आङ्,
To revile, to abuse or censure.
With उप,
To reproach.
With प्र,
To cry aloud, to shout.

m. (-श्वा)
A jackall.
E.
क्रुश to cry or howl, Uṇādi affix क्वनिप्.

mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं)
1 Wept, cried.
2 Cried aloud, bawled.
n. (-ष्टं)
1 Weeping, sobbing.
2 Noise, sound.
E.
क्रुश to weep, affix क्त.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
1 Cruel, pitiless.
2 Hard, harsh.
3 Hard, solid.
4 Mischievous, destructive.
5 Formidable, terrible.
6 Hot, sharp.
7 Disagreeable.
m. (-रः)
1 An odd sign of the zodiac, as the first, third, fifth, &c. which are of malignant influences.
2 A hawk.
3 A heron.
4 Red oleander.
E.
कृत to cut, रक् Uṇādi affix, and क्रू substituted for कृत.

mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म)
Fierce, cruel, unrelenting.
E.
क्रूर, and कर्म्मन् act.

m. (-ष्ठः)
Torpid or costive bowels unaffected by strong purgatives.
E.
क्रूर, and कोष्ठ the alimentary canal.

m. (-न्धः)
Sulphur.
E.
क्रूर, and गन्ध smell.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Cruel, ferocious, addicted to cruel practices.
E.
क्रूर, and चरित who practices.

f. (-ता)
Cruelty, fierceness.
E.
तल् added to the last; also with त्व, क्रूरत्वं.

mfn. (-दृक्)
Mischievous, villainous.
2 Evil-eyed.
m. (-दृक्)
A name of the planet Śani or Saturn.
E.
क्रूर cruel, &c. and दृश who sees, from दृश to see, affix क्विप्.

m. (-वी)
A raven.
E.
क्रूर formidable, राविन् who cries.

m. (-नः)
A name of Saturn.
E.
क्रूर evil, and लाचन an eye; of an evil or inauspicious aspect.

m. (-वः)
1 A jackall.
2 Any thing bad.

m. (-तिः)
A name of RĀVAṆA the ruler of Laṅkā.
E.
क्रूर evil, and आकृति figure, form.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Following barbarous or savage practices.
E.
क्रूर, and आचार observance.

mn. (-र्चः-र्चं)
The beard: see कूर्च्च.
